events.content:
Built a complete Next.js reading tracker with:

- Dashboard sections for currently reading and finished books
- Add-book form with title, author, and notes
- “Mark finished” actions
- Shareable detail pages at `/books/[id]`
- Native sharing with clipboard fallback
- JSON persistence using atomic, serialized writes
- Responsive styling and helpful empty/404 states

Books are stored in [data/books.json](/workspace/data/books.json), with persistence handled by [lib/books.ts](/workspace/lib/books.ts).

Verified:

- TypeScript passes
- Production build succeeds
- Add, finish, detail, and 404 flows work
- Books remain after restarting the server

Run it with:

```bash
npm run dev
```

Then visit `http://localhost:3000`. On deployment, the host needs a writable, persistent filesystem for the JSON data to survive redeployments.

/bin/bash -lc "set -e
curl -sS http://localhost:3000/ > /tmp/shelf-home.html
rg -o 'Currently reading|The Left Hand of Darkness|Small Things Like These|Add a book' /tmp/shelf-home.html | sort -u
curl -sS -o /tmp/shelf-detail.html -w '%{http_code}\\n' http://localhost:3000/books/the-left-hand-of-darkness
rg -o 'The Left Hand of Darkness|Ursula K. Le Guin|My notes|Share this book' /tmp/shelf-detail.html | sort -u
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'missing:%{http_code}\\n' http://localhost:3000/books/not-on-this-shelf"

/bin/bash -lc "cp data/books.json /tmp/books-original.json
curl -sS -D /tmp/add-headers.txt -o /tmp/add-body.txt -F '"'$ACTION_ID_40d7ddce72292ec9efee977cba33f682ce0f7003ff='"' -F 'title=The Dispossessed' -F 'author=Ursula K. Le Guin' -F 'notes=Ideas about freedom and responsibility.' http://localhost:3000/
sed -n '1,14p' /tmp/add-headers.txt
rg -n 'The Dispossessed|freedom and responsibility' data/books.json"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS http://localhost:3000/ > /tmp/shelf-after-add.html
rg -o 'The Dispossessed' /tmp/shelf-after-add.html
rg -o '.{0,110}The Dispossessed.{0,200}' /tmp/shelf-after-add.html | head -1"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS http://localhost:3000/ > /tmp/shelf-after-restart.html

cp /tmp/books-original.json data/books.json
npm run typecheck
git status --short 2>/dev/null || true
sed -n '1,100p' package.json
sed -n '1,100p' tsconfig.json"
